A heavy tsarist gold chervonets. Time has darkened it, but gold does not rust or lose value. How it reached the Zone is unknown: perhaps an old stalker hid it before the first Emission, or a black digger failed to smuggle it through the Perimeter. A trader will pay well for this pure, unalloyed gold.

A small cast bar marked with 999 fineness and the maker’s stamp. One hundred grams of pure gold, dense, heavy, and cold to the touch. Its origin is unknown; it may be an old reserve or contraband. It does not matter: gold is valuable everywhere, inside and beyond the Perimeter. Traders buy it without questions. Do not reveal where you found it.
